insight.finding: Geographic relevance is the primary triage signal. Most state-specific articles are HIGH for operators in that state, MEDIUM nationally. Fluff/consumer content is LOW regardless of state.
implications: affected_states accuracy is load-bearing for triage quality
deriveTier() must be state-aware at query time, not at ingest time
National HIGH threshold is higher than state-specific HIGH
Fluff pattern (activities, awards, local human interest) = LOW always

calibration.national_high: regulatory/compliance affecting all operators (KFF MA piece)
calibration.state_high: staffing rules, enforcement, M&A, closures in operators home states
calibration.medium: same state articles for operators not in that state
calibration.low: fluff, consumer content, activities, awards regardless of state
